d:
Decadent Wasteland is a post-invasion post-apocalypse science fiction story in the tradition of monster infused hentai.

After the devastating attack by an unknown alien force, with Earth's defences destroyed and the last remnants of the human race seeking sanctuary in the few remaining cities, our story begins in New Eden, a syndicate controlled city offering protection from the horrors of the Wasteland. This protection comes at a price - unswerving loyalty to the ruling elite, and a life of slavery.

But there is hope. A soldier from the war, Garon Sharpe, has gathered together a band of rebels, striking out at their captors - striving to one day wrestle control of the city from their oppressor's depraved hands.

A curfew has been called. Jila and Milo, long term citizens, secretly feeding information to the rebels, hurry back to their habitat cell, where they must witness an incoming city-wide broadcast...

FULL COMIC AVAILABLE AT https://subscribestar.adult/limitreacher
